name: Squash
description: A squash session: the clock, your heart rate, laps, and a FIT file that says squash rather than a workout that covered no ground. Uses a paired chest strap when one is connected and the wrist sensor when it is not. It does not count shots — turn on the raw motion recording below and it collects the data that would make counting them possible.

configFields.label: Record raw IMU
configFields.description: Stream the wrist sensor's raw 100 Hz motion to a CSV file beside the activity, for research. It fills flash fast and stops itself at 8 MB or 30 minutes, whichever comes first.
